title.narrative: Korttidsinsatser m.m. inom ramen för EU:s gemensamma säkerhets- och försvarspolitik
Short-term activities etc. within the European Common Security and Defence Policy

description.narrative: Among others that seconded staff are well-trained and prepared for their assignments and that the Swedish National Courts Administration supports the missions through its short-term activities. Also that personnel sent out to CSDP missions have a sound and thourough knowledge on sexual and gender based violence in a conflict setting.

Bl.a. att sekonderad personal är utbildad inför sina uppdrag och att Domstolsverket stödjer insatserna genom sina korttidsinsatser. Även att insatspersonal får med sig mer kunskap om könsbaserat och sexualiserat våld när de åker ut till insatser i konfliktområden.

Insatsförberedande utbildning och kompetenshöjande insatser samt annat insatsnära arbete, bl.a. lärarbidrag till en kurs vid European Security and Defence College (ESDC). Kursen handlar om att öka kompetensen hos insatspersonal när det gäller sexualiserat och könsbaserat våld i konfliktsituationer.

Pre-deployment training and short-term activities to support the missions as well as other work closely related to the missions, such as contributing with a teacher to a course at the European Security and Defence College (ESDC). The aim of the course at the ESDC is to enhance the capacity of mission personnel to integrate a Sexual and gender based violence perspective as part of their daily work.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: Trainings and activities were carried out as planned.
Utbildningar och aktiviteter har genomförts enligt plan.
